title: Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (HBOT) for Chronic Diabetic Lower Limb Ulcers
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if HBOT plus standard wound care is more effective than standard wound care alone at preventing the need for major amputation (metatarsal and up) in patients with diabetes mellitus (Type 1 or 2) with moderate to sever chronic wounds of lower limbs.
condition: Chronic Ulcers of the Lower Limb
